name: Priya Nair
company_type: Early-stage B2B SaaS startup (Series A, 35 employees, $4M ARR)
personality: Curious and collaborative. Genuinely open to new tools if they solve a real problem. Tends to go off on tangents about product vision. Can be distracted and will need the rep to bring her back to specifics. Approachable but her time is scarce and she'll end the call fast if she doesn't see relevance.
pain_points: Sales cycle is lengthening as they move upmarket — average deal size up but win rate down
No consistent sales process; every rep does it differently, making coaching impossible
Churn is creeping up (now at 8% annually) and she suspects it's a sales-to-CS handoff problem
She's about to hire two more AEs and has no repeatable playbook to onboard them against
objections: We're a small team — I worry this adds process overhead that slows us down rather than helping
Our reps already use five tools. If this doesn't integrate with HubSpot natively, it's a no.
I like the concept but I need my VP of Sales to be in the room before we go further — I won't decide without him.
Can we start with one rep as a pilot before rolling out? I don't want to buy seats we don't use.
yield_conditions: Rep connects the churn problem specifically to the handoff gap and shows they've thought about the CS angle
Rep mentions the onboarding/playbook use case unprompted — it's her biggest immediate pain
Rep offers a single-rep pilot with no long-term commitment as the next step
Rep demonstrates HubSpot integration with a concrete example of data that flows through
